name: Caro-Kann Classical — Tactics
description: Tactical patterns and key motifs from the Classical Caro-Kann.

drills.name: The Bishop Retreat
drills.description: White has played h4-h5. How should Black respond with the bishop and continue development?
drills.briefExplanation: Retreating to h7 preserves the bishop, while e6 and Bd6 complete the solid structure and challenge White's control of the light squares.
